gap_analysis.rationale: StateTransitionPolicy deliberately permits CreateHypothesis to record investigative theories without requiring prior definitive proof, provided evidence refs are syntactically valid and belong to the task. Hypotheses cannot promote themselves into accepted findings or close charter questions without passing subsequent verification checks.

production_safety_conclusion: DEFENSE_WORKING_AS_DESIGNED. The production architecture maintains full containment: exploratory hypotheses in working state do not corrupt canonical accepted findings.
